answer: Problem: cheap clone agents flood voting and dilute rewards. Mechanism: gate each identity through a cedar stake lock that only unlocks after the agent posts a unique work receipt hashed against an island-scoped epoch seed, then waits out a lagoon cool-down before the next claim. Cost: forgers must lock real stake per fake ID and burn cool-down time, so N Sybils scale linearly. Verification: peers recompute the receipt hash and check cool-down timestamps on-ledger. Failure: if cool-downs are shortened without raising stake floors, farms reappear overnight.
